page_title: ACM 4-1 TOR | AC Milan v Torino 26/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+4' AC Milan are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
90+2' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) receives a reproachful look from Christian Pulisic. He latches on to his pass, but the effort from the edge of the box sails high over the crossbar.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) tested Vanja Milinkovic-Savic with a strike from just outside the box, but the effort is saved.
89' Karol Linetty (Torino) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
88' Mike Maignan (AC Milan) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
87' The referee signals a substitution. Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) is brought on as a substitute for Theo Hernandez.
85' Mike Maignan (AC Milan) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
84' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
82' Yann Karamoh (Torino) is caught offside!
79' Substitution. Malick Thiaw did his best and is replaced by Simon Kjaer (AC Milan).
78' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) sends a cross into the box, but Mike Maignan comes off his line to gather the ball.
76' Pietro Pellegri (Torino) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
75' AC Milan seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
72' Ball possession – 61:39.
72' Yann Karamoh (Torino) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
70' Today's referee Maurizio Mariani rightly decides to book Malick Thiaw (AC Milan) for his harsh tackle.
69' Ricardo Rodriguez (Torino) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
66' Substitution. Olivier Giroud leaves the pitch and is replaced by Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan).
66' Stefano Pioli has decided to make a change. Noah Okafor (AC Milan) replaces Rafael Leao.
66' Substitution. Ruben Loftus-Cheek makes way for Yunus Musah (AC Milan).
65' 4 - 1 Goal! Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) puts the ball into the left side of the goal past the outstretched arm of Vanja Milinkovic-Savic.
64' Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
63' The AC Milan players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
62' Referee Maurizio Mariani makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
62' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from AC Milan for a penalty. Play continues.
61' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the area, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post.
59' Ivan Juric has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Yann Karamoh (Torino) replacing Nemanja Radonjic.
59' That's the end of the game for Raoul Bellanova, who is replaced by Valentino Lazaro (Torino).
57' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit.
57' The resulting corner from Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
57' What was Vanja Milinkovic-Savic (Torino) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
56' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) bends a great shot in from the edge of the box, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic makes a smart save to deny him.
55' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Torino.
52' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
51' Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle after Alessandro Buongiorno (Torino) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
48' Malick Thiaw (AC Milan) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Ivan Juric gives a chance to Karol Linetty (Torino) and Ivan Ilic is off.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+7' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+7' Raoul Bellanova (Torino) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
45+5' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) tries to find Theo Hernandez, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
45+2' 3 - 1 Goal! Rafael Leao gets to the ball, slips Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) into the area and he scores with a delightful chipped finish to make it 3:1.
45+2' The AC Milan players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
45' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
43' 2 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Vanja Milinkovic-Savic no chance!
43' Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) is going to take the penalty!
42' It’s a PENALTY to AC Milan after the VAR review!
40' Referee Maurizio Mariani makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for AC Milan. Let’s see what happens!
40' Surely that's handball by one of the Torino players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
39' The game is interrupted. Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
38' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
36' 1 - 1 Goal! Perr Schuurs (Torino) unleashes a first-time shot from inside the box and beats the goalkeeper inside the left post. 1:1.
35' A raking crossfield pass from Davide Calabria (AC Milan) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.
33' 1 - 0 Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) has acres of space after latching on to a precise pass into the box. He doesn't hesitate to unleash a great effort which ends up in the bottom left corner.
32' It's a free kick to AC Milan, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
31' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Nikola Vlasic (Torino). Maurizio Mariani saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. AC Milan are awarded the free kick.
29' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
28' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) sprays a pass out to Rafael Leao, but he can't beat his man to get to the ball.
26' Pietro Pellegri (Torino) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
25' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
23' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
21' Problems for Ivan Juric as Antonio Sanabria (Torino) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Pietro Pellegri replaces him.
19' Antonio Sanabria (Torino) wants to continue but the body doesn’t look willing!
19' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) produces a long-range volley, but the ball was blocked by a defender on its way.
18' Nemanja Radonjic (Torino) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
17' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
14' Ricardo Rodriguez (Torino) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.

13' A more precise finish was all that was needed for this set play to have been a success. Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) received the ball far out and fired a goal-bound projectile which went inches wide of the right post.
13' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
11' Ivan Ilic (Torino) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.
9' Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) has an effort on goal, but he misses to the right of the goal.
9' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
8' AC Milan show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted.
6' Ivan Ilic (Torino) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
5' Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
2' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
2' Malick Thiaw (AC Milan) smashes the ball upfield and Rafael Leao brings it down with a fine first touch.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Torino will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Maurizio Mariani.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
